description: Na₃B₆O₁₀Cl crystallizes in the orthorhombic P2_12_12₁ space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five O and one Cl atom. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.79 Å. The Na-Cl bond length is 2.79 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O and two equivalent Cl atoms to form distorted NaCl₂O₄ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaCl₂O₄ octahedra and edges with two BO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 59°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.65 Å. There is one shorter (2.85 Å) and one longer (2.91 Å) Na-Cl bond length. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six O and one Cl atom. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.48-2.98 Å. The Na-Cl bond length is 2.89 Å. There are six inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.37 Å) and two longer (1.38 Å) B-O bond lengths. In the second B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.37 Å) and one longer (1.38 Å) B-O bond length. In the third B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form BO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two BO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaCl₂O₄ octahedra. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.45-1.52 Å. In the fourth B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing BO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.53 Å. In the fifth B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.37 Å) and one longer (1.38 Å) B-O bond length. In the sixth B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form BO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two BO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaCl₂O₄ octahedra. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.52 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three B atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Na and two B atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Na and two B atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two B atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to two Na and two B atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Na and two B atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na and two B atoms. Cl is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four Na atoms.
